title: Make Pink Sheep Great Again
description: Prevents sheep and wool from being dyed pink, ultimately making pink sheep and their wool much rarer.
body:
🩷 Make Pink Sheep Great Again

🧱 Overview

The PinkWoolBlocker plugin is a lightweight, efficient server-side plugin that prevents players from obtaining pink wool through crafting or dyeing.

If a player attempts to craft pink wool or dye a sheep pink, the plugin intercepts the process, cancels it, and issues a warning message. After five failed attempts, the player is automatically kicked from the server to prevent spam-clicking or deliberate abuse.

🧠 Self-Contained:
No external dependencies required. Works instantly upon install.

🧩 Commands

This plugin does not require or add any commands.

🪪 Permissions

This plugin does not add any permissions — all players are affected equally.
